    If precision > 10 Then precision = 10

    Dim pattern As String
    If precision <= 0 Then
        pattern = "0"
    Else
        pattern = "0." & String$(precision, "0")
    End If
    FormatPlotValue = Replace$(Format$(value, pattern), ",", ".")
End Function

' Округляет неотрицательный размер маркера или номер цветовой ступени.
' Int до CLng сохраняет целые нечетные уровни и округляет ровно половину вверх.
Private Function RoundToLong(ByVal value As Double) As Long
    RoundToLong = CLng(Int(value + 0.5))
End Function

' Ограничивает значение заданным диапазоном.
Private Function ClampDouble(ByVal value As Double, ByVal minValue As Double, ByVal maxValue As Double) As Double
    ClampDouble = value
    If ClampDouble < minValue Then ClampDouble = minValue
    If ClampDouble > maxValue Then ClampDouble = maxValue
End Function

' Утилитарный максимум без WorksheetFunction в коде схемы.
Private Function MaxDouble(ByVal a As Double, ByVal b As Double) As Double
    If a > b Then MaxDouble = a Else MaxDouble = b
End Function

' Утилитарный минимум без WorksheetFunction в коде схемы.
Private Function MinDouble(ByVal a As Double, ByVal b As Double) As Double
    If a < b Then MinDouble = a Else MinDouble = b
End Function



====================================================================================================
COMPONENT: CSectionTypeRegistry
TYPE: 2
LINES: 248
====================================================================================================
Option Explicit

' ==========================================================================
' Реестр поддерживаемых типов сечений
' ==========================================================================
' Registry - единственная точка, где строка Geometry.Type из Config
' сопоставляется с конкретным набором классов формы: CGeometry*,
' *RebarLayoutBuilder и *AnnotationBuilder. Он не должен знать внутреннюю
' структуру таблиц граней и рядов конкретного сечения: такие детали остаются
' внутри специализированных builders. Отдельные provider-классы здесь
' сознательно не используются: обязательны геометрия с точными outer/opening
' и арматурный builder, а annotation builder необязателен. Новый тип
' подключается только здесь; ниже по цепочке используются общие контракты.

Private Const TYPE_CIRCLE As String = "circle" ' Ключ круглого сечения в Geometry.Type.
Private Const TYPE_RECTSET As String = "rectset" ' Ключ сечения из одного или двух прямоугольников в Geometry.Type.
Private Const TYPE_ROUNDED_RECTANGLE As String = "roundedrectangle" ' Ключ скругленного прямоугольника.
Private Const TYPE_HOLLOW_RECTANGLE As String = "hollowrectangle" ' Ключ пустотелого скругленного прямоугольника.

' Возвращает нормализованный тип встроенной геометрии из Config.
' Все публичные методы registry пользуются одним и тем же значением, поэтому
' новая форма регистрируется в одном месте и не расползается по workbook-коду.
Private Function ActiveGeometryType(ByVal settings As CSystemSettingsReader) As String
    If settings Is Nothing Then Err.Raise vbObjectError + 4135, _
        "CSectionTypeRegistry", "Настройки Config не переданы."

    Dim geometryType As String
    geometryType = LCase$(settings.GetRequiredChoice("Geometry.Type", _
        Array("Circle", "RectSet", "RoundedRectangle", "HollowRectangle")))

    Select Case geometryType
        Case TYPE_CIRCLE, TYPE_RECTSET, TYPE_ROUNDED_RECTANGLE, TYPE_HOLLOW_RECTANGLE
            ActiveGeometryType = geometryType
        Case Else
            Err.Raise vbObjectError + 4134, "CSectionTypeRegistry", _
                "Неподдерживаемый тип сечения Geometry.Type: " & settings.GetString("Geometry.Type", "RectSet")
    End Select
End Function

' Создает математическую форму сечения для Geometry.Source = Generated.
' Здесь допустим shape-specific Select Case: это единственная точка регистрации
' встроенных форм. Ниже по цепочке расчетное ядро видит только ISectionGeometry.
Public Function CreateGeometry(ByVal settings As CSystemSettingsReader, ByVal units As CUnitSystem) As ISectionGeometry
    If units Is Nothing Then Err.Raise vbObjectError + 4135, "CSectionTypeRegistry", "Система единиц геометрии не передана."
    Dim circleGeometry As CGeometryCircle ' Конкретная математическая форма круга.
    Dim rectSetGeometry As CGeometryRectSet ' Математическая форма из одного/двух прямоугольников.
    Dim roundedGeometry As CGeometryRoundedRectangle ' Конкретная математическая форма скругленного прямоугольника.
    Dim hollowGeometry As CGeometryHollowRectangle ' Пустотелая форма: внешний RoundedRectangle минус Opening.

    Select Case ActiveGeometryType(settings)
        Case TYPE_CIRCLE
            Set circleGeometry = New CGeometryCircle
            circleGeometry.InitializeByDiameter units.InputLengthToInternal(settings.GetRequiredDouble("Circle.Diameter")), 0#, 0#
            Set CreateGeometry = circleGeometry

        Case TYPE_RECTSET
            Set rectSetGeometry = New CGeometryRectSet
            Dim SectionType As String, lowerB As Double, lowerH As Double, upperOffset As Double
            SectionType = settings.GetRequiredChoice("RectSet.SectionType", _
                Array("Rectangle", "LSection", "TwoRectangles", "RectSet", "TwoRectangle", "TwoRectanglesOffset", "OffsetTwoRectangles"))
            If SectionType <> "Rectangle" Then
                lowerB = units.InputLengthToInternal(settings.GetRequiredDouble("RectSet.B2"))
                lowerH = units.InputLengthToInternal(settings.GetRequiredDouble("RectSet.H2"))
            End If
            If SectionType <> "Rectangle" And SectionType <> "LSection" And SectionType <> "RectSet" Then _
                upperOffset = units.InputLengthToInternal(settings.GetRequiredDouble("RectSet.UpperOffsetX"))
            rectSetGeometry.Initialize units.InputLengthToInternal(settings.GetRequiredDouble("RectSet.B1")), _
                units.InputLengthToInternal(settings.GetRequiredDouble("RectSet.H1")), _
                lowerB, lowerH, 0#, 0#, upperOffset, SectionType
            Set CreateGeometry = rectSetGeometry

        Case TYPE_ROUNDED_RECTANGLE
            Set roundedGeometry = New CGeometryRoundedRectangle
            Dim LeftType As String, RightType As String, LeftW As Double, RightW As Double, LeftR2 As Double, RightR2 As Double
            LeftType = settings.GetRequiredChoice("RoundedRectangle.Left.Type", Array("Simple", "Tapered"))
            RightType = settings.GetRequiredChoice("RoundedRectangle.Right.Type", Array("Simple", "Tapered"))
            If LeftType = "Tapered" Then
                LeftW = units.InputLengthToInternal(settings.GetRequiredDouble("RoundedRectangle.Left.W"))
                LeftR2 = units.InputLengthToInternal(settings.GetRequiredDouble("RoundedRectangle.Left.R2"))
            End If
            If RightType = "Tapered" Then
                RightW = units.InputLengthToInternal(settings.GetRequiredDouble("RoundedRectangle.Right.W"))
                RightR2 = units.InputLengthToInternal(settings.GetRequiredDouble("RoundedRectangle.Right.R2"))
            End If
            roundedGeometry.InitializeSides _
                units.InputLengthToInternal(settings.GetRequiredDouble("RoundedRectangle.B")), _
                units.InputLengthToInternal(settings.GetRequiredDouble("RoundedRectangle.H")), _
                LeftType, RightType, LeftW, RightW, _
                units.InputLengthToInternal(settings.GetRequiredDouble("RoundedRectangle.Left.R1")), _
                units.InputLengthToInternal(settings.GetRequiredDouble("RoundedRectangle.Right.R1")), LeftR2, RightR2
            Set CreateGeometry = roundedGeometry

        Case TYPE_HOLLOW_RECTANGLE
            Set hollowGeometry = New CGeometryHollowRectangle
            hollowGeometry.Initialize _
                units.InputLengthToInternal(settings.GetRequiredDouble("HollowRectangle.B")), _
                units.InputLengthToInternal(settings.GetRequiredDouble("HollowRectangle.H")), _
                units.InputLengthToInternal(settings.GetRequiredDouble("HollowRectangle.R")), _
                units.InputLengthToInternal(settings.GetRequiredDouble("HollowRectangle.OpeningB")), _
                units.InputLengthToInternal(settings.GetRequiredDouble("HollowRectangle.OpeningH")), _
                units.InputLengthToInternal(settings.GetRequiredDouble("HollowRectangle.OpeningR")), _
                units.InputLengthToInternal(settings.GetRequiredDouble("HollowRectangle.InnerOffsetX")), _
                units.InputLengthToInternal(settings.GetRequiredDouble("HollowRectangle.InnerOffsetY"))
            Set CreateGeometry = hollowGeometry
    End Select
End Function

' Создает раскладку арматуры для активной встроенной формы.
' Registry выбирает нужный builder, а чтение shape-specific ключей Config
' выполняет сам builder. Так таблица граней RectSet и правила дополнительных
' рядов не размазываются по общему registry.
Public Function CreateRebars(ByVal geometry As ISectionGeometry, ByVal settings As CSystemSettingsReader, _
        ByVal units As CUnitSystem) As CRebarLayout
    Dim circleRebars As CCircleRebarLayoutBuilder ' Генератор раскладки арматуры для кругового сечения.
    Dim rectSetRebars As CRectSetRebarLayoutBuilder ' Генератор раскладки арматуры для RectSet-сечения.
    Dim roundedRebars As CRoundedRectRebarLayoutBuilder ' Генератор арматуры для RoundedRectangle-сечения.
    Dim hollowRebars As CHollowRectRebarLayoutBuilder ' Генератор арматуры для HollowRectangle-сечения.

    Select Case ActiveGeometryType(settings)
        Case TYPE_CIRCLE
            Set circleRebars = New CCircleRebarLayoutBuilder
            Set CreateRebars = circleRebars.BuildFromSettings(settings, units)

        Case TYPE_RECTSET
            Set rectSetRebars = New CRectSetRebarLayoutBuilder
            Set CreateRebars = rectSetRebars.BuildFromSettings(settings, units)

        Case TYPE_ROUNDED_RECTANGLE
            Set roundedRebars = New CRoundedRectRebarLayoutBuilder
            Set CreateRebars = roundedRebars.BuildFromSettings(settings, units)

        Case TYPE_HOLLOW_RECTANGLE
            Set hollowRebars = New CHollowRectRebarLayoutBuilder
            Set CreateRebars = hollowRebars.BuildFromSettings(settings, units)
    End Select
End Function

' Добавляет semantic-аннотации формы в готовую CSectionModel.
' AnnotationBuilder получает модельные координаты и смысловые группы арматуры;
' Excel/Chart-координаты по-прежнему рассчитывает только layout/plot layer.
' Контуры здесь не создаются и не очищаются. Если зарегистрированная форма
' не имеет annotation builder, модель остается без размеров/подписей граней;
' геометрия и классификация всех отверстий уже подготовлены независимо.
Public Sub BuildAnnotations(ByVal model As CSectionModel, ByVal geometry As ISectionGeometry, _
        ByVal rebars As CRebarLayout, ByVal settings As CSystemSettingsReader)
    If model Is Nothing Then Err.Raise vbObjectError + 4136, "CSectionTypeRegistry", "Модель сечения не передана."
    If geometry Is Nothing Then Err.Raise vbObjectError + 4137, "CSectionTypeRegistry", "Геометрия сечения не передана."

    Dim circleAnnotations As CCircleAnnotationBuilder ' Формирует semantic-размеры и подписи арматуры для круга.
    Dim rectSetAnnotations As CRectSetAnnotationBuilder ' Формирует semantic-аннотации для граней RectSet-сечения.
    Dim roundedAnnotations As CRoundedRectAnnotationBuilder ' Формирует semantic-аннотации скругленного прямоугольника.
    Dim hollowAnnotations As CHollowRectAnnotationBuilder ' Формирует semantic-аннотации наружного контура и Opening.

    model.annotations.clear

    Select Case ActiveGeometryType(settings)
        Case TYPE_CIRCLE
            Set circleAnnotations = New CCircleAnnotationBuilder
            circleAnnotations.Build model, geometry, rebars

        Case TYPE_RECTSET
            Set rectSetAnnotations = New CRectSetAnnotationBuilder
            rectSetAnnotations.Build model, geometry, rebars

        Case TYPE_ROUNDED_RECTANGLE
            Set roundedAnnotations = New CRoundedRectAnnotationBuilder
            roundedAnnotations.Build model, geometry, rebars

        Case TYPE_HOLLOW_RECTANGLE
            Set hollowAnnotations = New CHollowRectAnnotationBuilder
            hollowAnnotations.Build model, geometry, rebars
    End Select
End Sub

' Собирает Generated-модель целиком: форму, бетонную сетку, арматуру и
' точные контуры с ролями и необязательные semantic-аннотации. Новый тип
' требует геометрию и арматурный builder, необязательно annotation builder;
' writer/reader/layout/plotter и расчетные потребители не меняются.
Public Function BuildGeneratedModel(ByVal settings As CSystemSettingsReader, ByVal units As CUnitSystem) As CSectionModel
    Dim geometry As ISectionGeometry
    Set geometry = CreateGeometry(settings, units)

    Dim mesh As CFiberMeshBuilder
    Set mesh = New CFiberMeshBuilder

    Dim meshStepX As Double ' Обязательный шаг бетонной сетки по X во внутренних единицах.
    Dim meshStepY As Double ' Обязательный независимый шаг бетонной сетки по Y.
    meshStepX = ReadMeshStep(settings, units, "Mesh.StepX")
    meshStepY = ReadMeshStep(settings, units, "Mesh.StepY")
    mesh.BuildMesh geometry, meshStepX, meshStepY, 1, MeshBoundarySubdivisions(settings)

    Dim rebars As CRebarLayout
    Set rebars = CreateRebars(geometry, settings, units)
    If rebars Is Nothing Then
        Err.Raise vbObjectError + 4138, "CSectionTypeRegistry", _
            "Для выбранного параметрического сечения не создана раскладка арматуры."
    End If
    If rebars.count = 0 Then
        Err.Raise vbObjectError + 4138, "CSectionTypeRegistry", _
            "Для выбранного параметрического сечения не задан ни один стержень арматуры. " & _
            "Допустимо оставить отдельные грани без арматуры, но в сечении должен быть хотя бы один стержень."
    End If

    Dim model As CSectionModel
    Dim modelBuilder As CSectionModelBuilder
    Set modelBuilder = New CSectionModelBuilder
    Set model = modelBuilder.BuildFromGenerated(mesh, rebars, "Generated")
    geometry.BuildContours model.contours
    BuildAnnotations model, geometry, rebars, settings
    Set BuildGeneratedModel = model
End Function

' Читает положительный шаг и нормализует INPUT длину до построения сетки.
' Диагностика адаптера сохраняет ключ и действующий адрес; builder независимо
' защищает свой внутренний API от невалидного шага без зависимости от Excel.
Private Function ReadMeshStep(ByVal settings As CSystemSettingsReader, ByVal units As CUnitSystem, ByVal key As String) As Double
    Dim value As Double
    value = settings.GetRequiredDouble(key)
    If value <= 0# Then Err.Raise vbObjectError + 4139, "CSectionTypeRegistry", _
        settings.InputErrorMessage(key, "Шаг бетонной сетки должен быть положительным.", _
            "Введите число больше нуля в текущей INPUT-единице длины.")
    On Error GoTo InvalidConversion
    ReadMeshStep = units.InputLengthToInternal(value)
    Exit Function
InvalidConversion:
    If Err.number <> 6 Then Err.Raise Err.number, Err.source, Err.description
    Err.Raise vbObjectError + 4139, "CSectionTypeRegistry", _
        settings.InputErrorMessage(key, "Шаг слишком велик для пересчета в мм.", _
            "Уменьшите число и проверьте INPUT-единицу длины.")
End Function

' Возвращает число подъячеек для уточнения границы бетонной сетки.
' Настройка общая для всех встроенных форм и не относится к конкретной
' geometry/rebar/annotation реализации.
Public Function MeshBoundarySubdivisions(ByVal settings As CSystemSettingsReader) As Long
    If settings Is Nothing Then Err.Raise vbObjectError + 4139, "CSectionTypeRegistry", "Настройки разбиения бетонной сетки не переданы."
    If settings.HasKey("Mesh.BoundarySubdivisions") Then
        Dim rawValue As String
        rawValue = Trim$(settings.GetRawString("Mesh.BoundarySubdivisions"))
        If Len(rawValue) = 0 Or UCase$(rawValue) = "TODO" Then Err.Raise vbObjectError + 4139, "CSectionTypeRegistry", _
            settings.InputErrorMessage("Mesh.BoundarySubdivisions", "Число подъячеек не задано.", "Введите целое число не меньше 1.")
    End If
    MeshBoundarySubdivisions = settings.GetRequiredLong("Mesh.BoundarySubdivisions")
    If MeshBoundarySubdivisions < 1 Then Err.Raise vbObjectError + 4139, "CSectionTypeRegistry", _
        settings.InputErrorMessage("Mesh.BoundarySubdivisions", "Число подъячеек меньше 1.", "Введите целое число не меньше 1.")
End Function



====================================================================================================
COMPONENT: CStabilitySummaryWriter
TYPE: 2
LINES: 885
====================================================================================================
Option Explicit

' ==========================================================================
' Детальная таблица продольного изгиба и устойчивости на листе Results
' ==========================================================================
' Класс пишет отдельный блок от якоря rngStabilitySummaryAnchor. Расчет здесь
' не выполняется: writer только берет уже сохраненные в batch величины
' устойчивости, переводит их в пользовательские единицы и оформляет таблицу.
'
' Верхний rngBatchSummary остается компактной общей сводкой, а этот блок дает
' подробную расшифровку по главным плоскостям и выбранному нормативу СП 35/СП 63.

Private Const HEADER_ROWS As Long = 5 ' Количество строк шапки над якорем.
Private Const TOTAL_COLUMNS As Long = 84 ' Ширина таблицы с пустыми разделителями между блоками.

Private Const COL_SUMMARY_FIRST As Long = 1
Private Const COL_SUMMARY_LAST As Long = 14
Private Const COL_COMMON_FIRST As Long = 16
Private Const COL_COMMON_LAST As Long = 27
Private Const COL_SP35_FIRST As Long = 29
Private Const COL_SP35_LAST As Long = 59
Private Const COL_SP63_FIRST As Long = 61
Private Const COL_SP63_LAST As Long = 84

Private Const SP35_PLANE1_FIRST As Long = 30
Private Const SP35_PLANE2_FIRST As Long = 45
Private Const SP63_PLANE1_FIRST As Long = 61
Private Const SP63_PLANE2_FIRST As Long = 73

Private Const HEADER_COLOR As Long = &HD9D9D9 ' Серый фон шапки, как в остальных таблицах Results.
Private Const SMALL_VALUE As Double = 0.000000001 ' Малый порог для деления и пустых расчетных полей.

' Возвращает количество строк шапки, которые writer строит выше rngStabilitySummaryAnchor.
Public Function HeaderRowsAboveAnchor() As Long
    HeaderRowsAboveAnchor = HEADER_ROWS
End Function

' Возвращает полную высоту таблицы устойчивости с учетом шапки над якорем.
Public Function RequiredRows(ByVal combinationCount As Long) As Long
    If combinationCount < 1 Then combinationCount = 1
    RequiredRows = HEADER_ROWS + combinationCount
End Function

' Возвращает число строк данных, которое нужно оформить под доступные LC.
' Заполненные сочетания берутся из batch, а пустая сетка - из высоты rngLoadCombinations.
Public Function RequiredDataRowsForWorkbook(ByVal Workbook As Object, ByVal combinationCount As Long) As Long
    RequiredDataRowsForWorkbook = combinationCount
    If RequiredDataRowsForWorkbook < 1 Then RequiredDataRowsForWorkbook = 1

    On Error GoTo SafeExit
    If Workbook Is Nothing Then GoTo SafeExit
    Dim loads As Object
    Set loads = Workbook.names.item("rngLoadCombinations").RefersToRange
    If loads.rows.count > 1 Then
        If loads.rows.count - 1 > RequiredDataRowsForWorkbook Then _
            RequiredDataRowsForWorkbook = loads.rows.count - 1
    End If
SafeExit:
    If RequiredDataRowsForWorkbook < 1 Then RequiredDataRowsForWorkbook = 1
End Function

' Возвращает полную высоту таблицы для фактической книги, включая пустые
' доступные строки сочетаний, которые тоже должны иметь рамки.
Public Function RequiredRowsForWorkbook(ByVal Workbook As Object, ByVal combinationCount As Long) As Long
    RequiredRowsForWorkbook = RequiredRows(RequiredDataRowsForWorkbook(Workbook, combinationCount))
End Function

' Возвращает полную ширину таблицы устойчивости, включая пустые столбцы-разделители.
Public Function RequiredColumns() As Long
    RequiredColumns = TOTAL_COLUMNS
End Function

' Записывает детальную таблицу устойчивости от якоря rngStabilitySummaryAnchor.
Public Sub WriteSummary(ByVal Workbook As Object, ByVal batch As CBatchSectionCalculator, _
        Optional ByVal units As CUnitSystem = Nothing)
    On Error GoTo Failed
    If Workbook Is Nothing Then Err.Raise vbObjectError + 3980, "CStabilitySummaryWriter", "Книга Excel не передана."
    If batch Is Nothing Then Err.Raise vbObjectError + 3981, "CStabilitySummaryWriter", "Пакетный расчетчик не передан."

    Dim target As Object
    Set target = TargetRange(Workbook, RequiredDataRowsForWorkbook(Workbook, batch.count))
    PrepareTarget target
    WriteBlockTitle target, "Расчет продольного изгиба и устойчивости"
    WriteHeaders target, units, batch
    WriteData target, batch, units
    FormatTable target, batch
    Exit Sub

Failed:
    Err.Raise Err.number, "CStabilitySummaryWriter.WriteSummary", Err.description
End Sub

' Полностью очищает старый блок устойчивости вместе с объединениями и форматами.
Public Sub ClearSummary(ByVal Workbook As Object)
    If Workbook Is Nothing Then Err.Raise vbObjectError + 3982, "CStabilitySummaryWriter", "Книга Excel не передана."
    PrepareTarget ClearTargetRange(Workbook)
End Sub

' Возвращает полный диапазон таблицы: пять строк шапки над якорем и фактические строки LC.
Private Function TargetRange(ByVal Workbook As Object, Optional ByVal dataRows As Long = 1) As Object
    Dim anchor As Object
    Set anchor = Workbook.names.item("rngStabilitySummaryAnchor").RefersToRange
    If anchor.row <= HEADER_ROWS Then Err.Raise vbObjectError + 3983, "CStabilitySummaryWriter", _
        "rngStabilitySummaryAnchor должен иметь место для шапки над собой."
    Set TargetRange = anchor.offset(-HEADER_ROWS, 0).Resize(RequiredRows(dataRows), TOTAL_COLUMNS)
End Function

' Возвращает область очистки старой таблицы до следующего нижнего якоря Results.
Private Function ClearTargetRange(ByVal Workbook As Object) As Object
    Dim anchor As Object
    Set anchor = Workbook.names.item("rngStabilitySummaryAnchor").RefersToRange
    If anchor.row <= HEADER_ROWS Then Err.Raise vbObjectError + 3983, "CStabilitySummaryWriter", _
        "rngStabilitySummaryAnchor должен иметь место для шапки над собой."

    Dim topRow As Long
    topRow = anchor.row - HEADER_ROWS

    Dim rowsToClear As Long
    rowsToClear = RequiredRows(1)

    On Error GoTo UseDefaultHeight
    Dim nextAnchor As Object
    Set nextAnchor = Workbook.names.item("rngNDMElementResults").RefersToRange
    If nextAnchor.row > topRow Then rowsToClear = nextAnchor.row - topRow

UseDefaultHeight:
    If topRow + rowsToClear - 1 > anchor.Worksheet.rows.count Then _
        rowsToClear = anchor.Worksheet.rows.count - topRow + 1
    Set ClearTargetRange = anchor.Worksheet.cells(topRow, anchor.column).Resize(rowsToClear, TOTAL_COLUMNS)
End Function

' Снимает старые объединения и чистит область, чтобы при переносе якоря не осталось старой верстки.
Private Sub PrepareTarget(ByVal target As Object)
    ClearBlockTitleRow target
    target.UnMerge
    target.clear
End Sub

' Записывает отдельную строку-название над detailed-блоком устойчивости.
Private Sub WriteBlockTitle(ByVal target As Object, ByVal titleText As String)
    If target.row <= 1 Then Exit Sub

    Dim titleRow As Long
    titleRow = target.row - 1
    target.Worksheet.cells(titleRow, target.column).Resize(1, TOTAL_COLUMNS).Interior.color = RGB(189, 215, 238)
    target.Worksheet.rows.item(titleRow).RowHeight = 15
    With target.Worksheet.cells(titleRow, target.column)
        .value2 = titleText
        .font.name = "Arial"
        .font.size = 12
        .font.Bold = True
        .font.color = RGB(255, 0, 0)
        .HorizontalAlignment = -4131
        .VerticalAlignment = -4108
        .WrapText = False
    End With
End Sub

' Очищает название и заливку только в ширине блока устойчивости. Данные
' справа от таблицы не принадлежат writer-у и не затрагиваются очисткой.
Private Sub ClearBlockTitleRow(ByVal target As Object)
    If target.row <= 1 Then Exit Sub
    target.Worksheet.cells(target.row - 1, target.column).Resize(1, TOTAL_COLUMNS).clear
    target.Worksheet.rows.item(target.row - 1).RowHeight = 15
End Sub

' Формирует многоуровневую шапку таблицы. Разделительные столбцы остаются пустыми.
Private Sub WriteHeaders(ByVal target As Object, ByVal units As CUnitSystem, _
        ByVal batch As CBatchSectionCalculator)
    MergeCells target, 1, COL_SUMMARY_FIRST, 1, BlockWidth(COL_SUMMARY_FIRST, COL_SUMMARY_LAST), _
        "Итог по расчету (с учетом " & ChrW$(&H3B7) & ")"
    MergeCells target, 2, 1, 4, 1, "Combination ID"
    MergeCells target, 2, 2, 4, 1, "ResultComment"
    MergeCells target, 2, 3, 4, 1, "общий статус"
    MergeCells target, 2, 4, 2, 5, "относительно главных центральных осей приведенного сечения"
    MergeCells target, 2, 9, 2, 3, "относительно центральных осей приведенного сечения"
    MergeCells target, 2, 12, 2, 3, "в точке приложения нагрузок"

    MergeCells target, 1, COL_COMMON_FIRST, 1, BlockWidth(COL_COMMON_FIRST, COL_COMMON_LAST), _
        "Общие данные для учета продольного изгиба и проверки устойчивости (по главным осям 1, 2)"
    MergeCells target, 2, 16, 1, 6, "Нагрузки до применения " & ChrW$(&H3B7) & " в ц.т. приведенного сечения"
    MergeCells target, 3, 16, 1, 3, "постоянные + временные"
    MergeCells target, 3, 19, 1, 3, "постоянные"
    MergeCells target, 2, 22, 2, 6, "характеристики сечения"

    MergeCells target, 1, COL_SP35_FIRST, 1, BlockWidth(COL_SP35_FIRST, COL_SP35_LAST), "Расчет по СП 35"
    MergeCells target, 2, 29, 3, 1, "общие для СП"
    WriteSP35PlaneHeaders target, SP35_PLANE1_FIRST, "Плоскость 1 (изгиб вокруг главной оси 1)"
    WriteSP35PlaneHeaders target, SP35_PLANE2_FIRST, "Плоскость 2 (изгиб вокруг главной оси 2)"

    MergeCells target, 1, COL_SP63_FIRST, 1, BlockWidth(COL_SP63_FIRST, COL_SP63_LAST), "Расчет по СП 63"
    WriteSP63PlaneHeaders target, SP63_PLANE1_FIRST, "Плоскость 1 (изгиб вокруг главной оси 1)"
    WriteSP63PlaneHeaders target, SP63_PLANE2_FIRST, "Плоскость 2 (изгиб вокруг главной оси 2)"

    PutHeaderNotes target
    PutHeaderRowLabels target, units, batch
End Sub

' Записывает верхние подписи для одной плоскости СП 35.
Private Sub WriteSP35PlaneHeaders(ByVal target As Object, ByVal firstColumn As Long, ByVal titleText As String)
    MergeCells target, 2, firstColumn, 1, 15, titleText
    MergeCells target, 3, firstColumn, 1, 3, "Общие для плоскости"
    MergeCells target, 3, firstColumn + 3, 1, 6, "при ec > r"
    MergeCells target, 3, firstColumn + 9, 1, 6, "при ec <= r"
End Sub

' Записывает верхние подписи для одной плоскости СП 63.
Private Sub WriteSP63PlaneHeaders(ByVal target As Object, ByVal firstColumn As Long, ByVal titleText As String)
    MergeCells target, 2, firstColumn, 2, 12, titleText
End Sub

' Формирует заголовок запаса для ветви СП 35 ec > r.
' В нем показывается не условное k, а фактический лимит N/Ncr,
' заданный пользователем в Stability.SP35.NOverNcrLimit.
Private Function SP35EtaReserveLabel(ByVal batch As CBatchSectionCalculator) As String
    Dim limitValue As Double
    limitValue = 0.7
    If Not batch Is Nothing Then
        If batch.StabilitySP35NOverNcrLimit > SMALL_VALUE Then _
            limitValue = batch.StabilitySP35NOverNcrLimit
    End If
    SP35EtaReserveLabel = FormatCoefficientInvariant(limitValue) & "*Ncr/N"
End Function

' Пишет коэффициент в заголовок с точкой в качестве десятичного разделителя.
Private Function FormatCoefficientInvariant(ByVal value As Double) As String
    FormatCoefficientInvariant = Replace$(Format$(value, "0.############"), ",", ".")
End Function

' Заполняет подписи одной плоскости СП 35, сохраняя раздельные колонки для
' ветвей ec > r и ec <= r.
Private Sub PutSP35PlaneLabels(ByRef labels() As Variant, ByVal firstColumn As Long, _
        ByVal units As CUnitSystem, ByVal etaReserveLabel As String)
    labels(1, firstColumn) = "ec,sl, " & OutputLengthUnit(units)
    labels(1, firstColumn + 1) = "ec, " & OutputLengthUnit(units)
    labels(1, firstColumn + 2) = "r, " & OutputLengthUnit(units)
    labels(1, firstColumn + 3) = "Ncr, " & OutputForceUnit(units)
    labels(1, firstColumn + 4) = ChrW$(&H3B4)
    labels(1, firstColumn + 5) = ChrW$(&H3C6) & "l (пост)"
    labels(1, firstColumn + 6) = ChrW$(&H3B7)
    labels(1, firstColumn + 7) = etaReserveLabel
    labels(1, firstColumn + 8) = "статус"
    labels(1, firstColumn + 9) = ChrW$(&H3C6) & "l (табл)"
    labels(1, firstColumn + 10) = ChrW$(&H3C6) & "m"
    labels(1, firstColumn + 11) = ChrW$(&H3C6)
    labels(1, firstColumn + 12) = "Nult, " & OutputForceUnit(units)
    labels(1, firstColumn + 13) = "Nult/N"
    labels(1, firstColumn + 14) = "статус"
End Sub

' Заполняет обозначения одной плоскости СП 63.

' Записывает строки LC одним массивом.
Private Sub WriteData(ByVal target As Object, ByVal batch As CBatchSectionCalculator, ByVal units As CUnitSystem)
    Dim data() As Variant
    Dim dataRows As Long
    dataRows = target.rows.count - HEADER_ROWS
    If dataRows < 1 Then dataRows = 1
    ReDim data(1 To dataRows, 1 To TOTAL_COLUMNS)

    Dim i As Long
    For i = 1 To batch.count
        PutCombination data, OutputDataOffset(batch, i, dataRows), batch, i, units
    Next i

    target.offset(HEADER_ROWS, 0).Resize(dataRows, TOTAL_COLUMNS).value2 = data
End Sub

' Возвращает позицию LC внутри data-части подробной таблицы.
' Основной поток читает offset из rngLoadCombinations; прямые тесты без offset продолжают выводиться компактно.
Private Function OutputDataOffset(ByVal batch As CBatchSectionCalculator, ByVal index As Long, ByVal dataRows As Long) As Long
    OutputDataOffset = batch.SourceDataOffset(index)
    If OutputDataOffset < 1 Then OutputDataOffset = index
    If OutputDataOffset > dataRows Then OutputDataOffset = index
    If OutputDataOffset > dataRows Then OutputDataOffset = dataRows
End Function

' Возвращает внешний статус канонической устойчивости через общую policy.
Private Function StabilityStatusText(ByVal batch As CBatchSectionCalculator, ByVal index As Long, _
        ByVal policy As CResultStatusPolicy) As String
    Dim meta As CResultMeta
    Set meta = batch.ResultAt(index).stabilityMeta
    StabilityStatusText = policy.ExternalStatus(meta)
End Function

' Возвращает готовое пользовательское пояснение из ResultMeta блока.
' Writer не анализирует технические StopReason и не собирает комментарий заново.
Private Function MetaComment(ByVal meta As CResultMeta) As String
    If meta Is Nothing Then Exit Function
    MetaComment = meta.resultComment
End Function

' Заполняет строку готовыми величинами и комментарием результата устойчивости.
' Подробные числовые поля доступны только завершенной проверке; активная ветвь
' СП 35/СП 63 выбирается по сохраненному результату, без повторения формул.
Private Sub PutCombination(ByRef data() As Variant, ByVal rowIndex As Long, _
        ByVal batch As CBatchSectionCalculator, ByVal index As Long, ByVal units As CUnitSystem)
    Dim policy As CResultStatusPolicy
    Set policy = StatusPolicy()

    Dim statusText As String
    statusText = StabilityStatusText(batch, index, policy)
    data(rowIndex, 1) = batch.combinationID(index)
    data(rowIndex, 2) = MetaComment(batch.ResultAt(index).stabilityMeta)
    data(rowIndex, 3) = statusText
    PutDefaultStatusCells data, rowIndex, policy.NotApplicable
    If statusText = policy.NotApplicable Then Exit Sub
    If Not policy.IsFinished(statusText) Then Exit Sub

    data(rowIndex, 4) = OptionalValue(batch.ResultAt(index).StabilityResult.Eta1)
    data(rowIndex, 5) = OptionalValue(batch.ResultAt(index).StabilityResult.Eta2)
    data(rowIndex, 6) = OutputForce(batch.ResultAt(index).StabilityResult.designN, units)
    data(rowIndex, 7) = OutputMomentMagnitude(batch.ResultAt(index).StabilityResult.DesignMoment1, units)
    data(rowIndex, 8) = OutputMomentMagnitude(batch.ResultAt(index).StabilityResult.DesignMoment2, units)
    data(rowIndex, 9) = OutputForce(batch.ResultAt(index).StabilityResult.designN, units)
    data(rowIndex, 10) = OutputMx(batch.ResultAt(index).StabilityResult.DesignMx, units)
    data(rowIndex, 11) = OutputMy(batch.ResultAt(index).StabilityResult.DesignMy, units)
    data(rowIndex, 12) = OutputForce(batch.ResultAt(index).StabilityResult.designN, units)
    data(rowIndex, 13) = OutputMx(batch.StabilityLoadPointMx(index), units)
    data(rowIndex, 14) = OutputMy(batch.StabilityLoadPointMy(index), units)

    data(rowIndex, 16) = OutputForce(batch.ResultAt(index).StabilityResult.designN, units)
    data(rowIndex, 17) = OutputMomentMagnitude(batch.ResultAt(index).StabilityResult.Moment1, units)
    data(rowIndex, 18) = OutputMomentMagnitude(batch.ResultAt(index).StabilityResult.Moment2, units)
    data(rowIndex, 19) = OutputSignedCompressionForce(batch.ResultAt(index).StabilityResult.sustainedN, units)
    data(rowIndex, 20) = OutputMomentMagnitude(batch.ResultAt(index).StabilityResult.SustainedMoment1, units)
    data(rowIndex, 21) = OutputMomentMagnitude(batch.ResultAt(index).StabilityResult.SustainedMoment2, units)
    data(rowIndex, 22) = OutputLength(batch.ResultAt(index).StabilityResult.Depth1, units)
    data(rowIndex, 23) = OutputLength(batch.ResultAt(index).StabilityResult.Depth2, units)
    data(rowIndex, 24) = OutputLength(batch.ResultAt(index).StabilityResult.Radius1, units)
    data(rowIndex, 25) = OutputLength(batch.ResultAt(index).StabilityResult.Radius2, units)
    data(rowIndex, 26) = OutputLength(batch.ResultAt(index).StabilityResult.EffectiveLength1, units)
    data(rowIndex, 27) = OutputLength(batch.ResultAt(index).StabilityResult.EffectiveLength2, units)

    If StrComp(batch.ResultAt(index).StabilityResult.code, "SP35", vbTextCompare) = 0 Then
        data(rowIndex, 29) = OptionalValue(MaxDouble(batch.ResultAt(index).StabilityResult.PhiP1, batch.ResultAt(index).StabilityResult.PhiP2))
        PutSP35PlaneValues data, rowIndex, SP35_PLANE1_FIRST, batch, index, 1, units
        PutSP35PlaneValues data, rowIndex, SP35_PLANE2_FIRST, batch, index, 2, units
    ElseIf StrComp(batch.ResultAt(index).StabilityResult.code, "SP63", vbTextCompare) = 0 Then
        PutSP63PlaneValues data, rowIndex, SP63_PLANE1_FIRST, batch, index, 1, units
        PutSP63PlaneValues data, rowIndex, SP63_PLANE2_FIRST, batch, index, 2, units
    End If
End Sub

' Заполняет одну плоскость СП 35. В строке активна только ветвь ec > r или ec <= r.
Private Sub PutSP35PlaneValues(ByRef data() As Variant, ByVal rowIndex As Long, ByVal firstColumn As Long, _
        ByVal batch As CBatchSectionCalculator, ByVal index As Long, ByVal planeIndex As Long, _
        ByVal units As CUnitSystem)
    Dim BranchName As String
    BranchName = PlaneBranch(batch, index, planeIndex)

    data(rowIndex, firstColumn) = OutputLength(PlaneAccidentalEccentricity(batch, index, planeIndex), units)
    data(rowIndex, firstColumn + 1) = OutputLength(PlaneEccentricity(batch, index, planeIndex), units)
    data(rowIndex, firstColumn + 2) = OutputLength(PlaneCoreDistance(batch, index, planeIndex), units)
    data(rowIndex, firstColumn + 3) = OptionalCompressionForce(PlaneNcr(batch, index, planeIndex), units)

    If StrComp(BranchName, "SP35-eta", vbTextCompare) = 0 Then
        data(rowIndex, firstColumn + 4) = OptionalValue(PlaneDelta(batch, index, planeIndex))
        data(rowIndex, firstColumn + 5) = OptionalValue(PlanePhiL(batch, index, planeIndex))
        data(rowIndex, firstColumn + 6) = OptionalValue(PlaneEta(batch, index, planeIndex))
        data(rowIndex, firstColumn + 7) = OptionalValue(PlaneReserve(batch, index, planeIndex))
        data(rowIndex, firstColumn + 8) = PlaneStatus(batch, index, planeIndex)
        data(rowIndex, firstColumn + 14) = StatusPolicy().NotApplicable
    ElseIf StrComp(BranchName, "SP35-table", vbTextCompare) = 0 Then
        data(rowIndex, firstColumn + 8) = StatusPolicy().NotApplicable
        data(rowIndex, firstColumn + 9) = OptionalValue(PlanePhiLTable(batch, index, planeIndex))
        data(rowIndex, firstColumn + 10) = OptionalValue(PlanePhiM(batch, index, planeIndex))
        data(rowIndex, firstColumn + 11) = OptionalValue(PlanePhiValue(batch, index, planeIndex))
        data(rowIndex, firstColumn + 12) = OptionalCompressionForce(PlaneNultimate(batch, index, planeIndex), units)
        data(rowIndex, firstColumn + 13) = RatioLimitToCompression(PlaneNultimate(batch, index, planeIndex), batch.ResultAt(index).StabilityResult.designN)
        data(rowIndex, firstColumn + 14) = PlaneStatus(batch, index, planeIndex)
    End If
End Sub

' Заполняет одну плоскость СП 63.
Private Sub PutSP63PlaneValues(ByRef data() As Variant, ByVal rowIndex As Long, ByVal firstColumn As Long, _
        ByVal batch As CBatchSectionCalculator, ByVal index As Long, ByVal planeIndex As Long, _
        ByVal units As CUnitSystem)
    data(rowIndex, firstColumn) = OptionalValue(PlaneSlenderness(batch, index, planeIndex))
    data(rowIndex, firstColumn + 1) = OutputLength(PlaneAccidentalEccentricity(batch, index, planeIndex), units)
    data(rowIndex, firstColumn + 2) = OutputLength(PlaneEccentricity(batch, index, planeIndex), units)
    data(rowIndex, firstColumn + 3) = OptionalValue(PlanePhiL(batch, index, planeIndex))
    data(rowIndex, firstColumn + 4) = OptionalValue(PlaneDelta(batch, index, planeIndex))
    data(rowIndex, firstColumn + 5) = OptionalValue(PlaneKb(batch, index, planeIndex))
    data(rowIndex, firstColumn + 6) = OptionalValue(PlaneKs(batch, index, planeIndex))
    data(rowIndex, firstColumn + 7) = OutputStiffness(PlaneStiffnessD(batch, index, planeIndex), units)
    data(rowIndex, firstColumn + 8) = OptionalCompressionForce(PlaneNcr(batch, index, planeIndex), units)
    data(rowIndex, firstColumn + 9) = OptionalValue(PlaneEta(batch, index, planeIndex))
    data(rowIndex, firstColumn + 10) = RatioLimitToCompression(PlaneNcr(batch, index, planeIndex), batch.ResultAt(index).StabilityResult.designN)
    data(rowIndex, firstColumn + 11) = PlaneStatus(batch, index, planeIndex)
End Sub

' Применяет общее оформление, границы блоков и независимую красную подсветку.
Private Sub FormatTable(ByVal target As Object, ByVal batch As CBatchSectionCalculator)
    target.font.name = "Arial"
    target.font.size = 9
    target.HorizontalAlignment = -4108
    target.VerticalAlignment = -4108
    target.WrapText = False
    target.rows.RowHeight = 15

    FormatBlock target, COL_SUMMARY_FIRST, COL_SUMMARY_LAST
    FormatBlock target, COL_COMMON_FIRST, COL_COMMON_LAST
    FormatBlock target, COL_SP35_FIRST, COL_SP35_LAST
    FormatBlock target, COL_SP63_FIRST, COL_SP63_LAST

    target.offset(0, 0).Resize(HEADER_ROWS, TOTAL_COLUMNS).font.Bold = True
    target.offset(0, 0).Resize(HEADER_ROWS, TOTAL_COLUMNS).WrapText = True
    target.offset(HEADER_ROWS - 1, 0).Resize(1, TOTAL_COLUMNS).WrapText = False
    FormatHeaderNotes target
    Dim dataRows As Long
    dataRows = target.rows.count - HEADER_ROWS
    If dataRows < 1 Then dataRows = 1
    target.offset(HEADER_ROWS, 0).Resize(dataRows, TOTAL_COLUMNS).WrapText = False
    target.offset(HEADER_ROWS, 0).Resize(dataRows, TOTAL_COLUMNS).NumberFormat = "0.000"
    target.offset(HEADER_ROWS, 0).Resize(dataRows, 3).NumberFormat = "@"
    target.offset(HEADER_ROWS, 1).Resize(dataRows, 1).HorizontalAlignment = -4131

    FormatStatusCells target, batch
End Sub

' Оформляет строку примечаний как обычный текст, а не как дополнительный заголовок.
Private Sub FormatHeaderNotes(ByVal target As Object)
    With target.offset(3, 0).Resize(1, TOTAL_COLUMNS)
        .font.Bold = False
        .font.size = 8
        .HorizontalAlignment = -4131
        .VerticalAlignment = -4108
        .WrapText = False
    End With
    target.Worksheet.rows.item(target.row + 3).RowHeight = 15
End Sub

' Оформляет один смысловой блок и не трогает пустой столбец-разделитель рядом.
Private Sub FormatBlock(ByVal target As Object, ByVal firstColumn As Long, ByVal lastColumn As Long)
    Dim block As Object
    Set block = target.offset(0, firstColumn - 1).Resize(target.rows.count, lastColumn - firstColumn + 1)
    block.Borders.LineStyle = 1
    block.Borders.color = RGB(0, 0, 0)
    block.Borders.weight = 2
    block.HorizontalAlignment = -4108
    block.VerticalAlignment = -4108
    target.offset(0, firstColumn - 1).Resize(HEADER_ROWS, lastColumn - firstColumn + 1).Interior.color = HEADER_COLOR
End Sub

' Красит блоки строки LC по итоговому статусу расчета устойчивости.
Private Sub FormatStatusCells(ByVal target As Object, ByVal batch As CBatchSectionCalculator)
    If batch Is Nothing Then Exit Sub

    Dim i As Long
    For i = 1 To batch.count
        Dim rowOffset As Long
        rowOffset = OutputDataOffset(batch, i, target.rows.count - HEADER_ROWS)
        If HEADER_ROWS + rowOffset > target.rows.count Then Exit For

        ApplyStatusCell target, HEADER_ROWS + rowOffset, 3
        ApplyStatusCell target, HEADER_ROWS + rowOffset, SP35_PLANE1_FIRST + 8
        ApplyStatusCell target, HEADER_ROWS + rowOffset, SP35_PLANE1_FIRST + 14
        ApplyStatusCell target, HEADER_ROWS + rowOffset, SP35_PLANE2_FIRST + 8
        ApplyStatusCell target, HEADER_ROWS + rowOffset, SP35_PLANE2_FIRST + 14
        ApplyStatusCell target, HEADER_ROWS + rowOffset, SP63_PLANE1_FIRST + 11
        ApplyStatusCell target, HEADER_ROWS + rowOffset, SP63_PLANE2_FIRST + 11
    Next i
End Sub

' Заполняет все статусные колонки нормативных ветвей значением N/A до записи выбранной методики.
Private Sub PutDefaultStatusCells(ByRef data() As Variant, ByVal rowIndex As Long, ByVal statusText As String)
    data(rowIndex, SP35_PLANE1_FIRST + 8) = statusText
    data(rowIndex, SP35_PLANE1_FIRST + 14) = statusText
    data(rowIndex, SP35_PLANE2_FIRST + 8) = statusText
    data(rowIndex, SP35_PLANE2_FIRST + 14) = statusText
    data(rowIndex, SP63_PLANE1_FIRST + 11) = statusText
    data(rowIndex, SP63_PLANE2_FIRST + 11) = statusText
End Sub

' Красит одну статусную ячейку detailed-блока устойчивости по единой палитре Results.
Private Sub ApplyStatusCell(ByVal target As Object, ByVal rowIndex As Long, ByVal columnIndex As Long)
    Dim cell As Object
    Set cell = target.cells(rowIndex, columnIndex)
    ApplyStatusFill cell, CStr(cell.value2)
End Sub

' Объединяет ячейки шапки и записывает текст.
Private Sub MergeCells(ByVal target As Object, ByVal rowIndex As Long, ByVal columnIndex As Long, _
        ByVal rowCount As Long, ByVal columnCount As Long, ByVal valueText As String)
    Dim area As Object
    Set area = target.offset(rowIndex - 1, columnIndex - 1).Resize(rowCount, columnCount)
    area.Merge
    area.value2 = valueText
End Sub

' Возвращает ширину блока по его первой и последней колонке.
Private Function BlockWidth(ByVal firstColumn As Long, ByVal lastColumn As Long) As Long
    BlockWidth = lastColumn - firstColumn + 1
End Function

' Делает нижние индексы в обозначениях без изменения самого текста заголовка.
Private Sub ApplyHeaderSubscripts(ByVal target As Object)
    Dim labels As Object
    Set labels = target.offset(4, 0).Resize(1, TOTAL_COLUMNS)

    Dim cell As Object
    For Each cell In labels.cells
        ApplySubscriptToken cell, "ec,sl", 2, 4
        ApplySubscriptToken cell, "ec", 2, 1
        ApplySubscriptToken cell, "ea", 2, 1
        ApplySubscriptToken cell, "e0", 2, 1
        ApplySubscriptToken cell, "l01", 2, 2
        ApplySubscriptToken cell, "l02", 2, 2
        ApplySubscriptToken cell, "l0/i", 2, 1
        ApplySubscriptToken cell, "Ncr", 2, 2
        ApplySubscriptToken cell, "Nult", 2, 3
        ApplySubscriptToken cell, "M1", 2, 1
        ApplySubscriptToken cell, "M2", 2, 1
        ApplySubscriptToken cell, ChrW$(&H3C6) & "p", 2, 1
        ApplySubscriptToken cell, ChrW$(&H3C6) & "l", 2, 1
        ApplySubscriptToken cell, ChrW$(&H3C6) & "m", 2, 1
        ApplySubscriptToken cell, ChrW$(&H3B4) & "e", 2, 1
        ApplySubscriptToken cell, "kb", 2, 1
        ApplySubscriptToken cell, "ks", 2, 1
    Next cell
End Sub

' Применяет нижний индекс к найденному техническому обозначению.
Private Sub ApplySubscriptToken(ByVal cell As Object, ByVal token As String, ByVal subStart As Long, ByVal subLength As Long)
    Dim valueText As String
    valueText = CStr(cell.value2)
    If Len(valueText) = 0 Then Exit Sub

    Dim position As Long
    position = InStr(1, valueText, token, vbBinaryCompare)
    If position <= 0 Then Exit Sub

    On Error Resume Next
    cell.Characters(position + subStart - 1, subLength).font.Subscript = True
    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub

' Возвращает статус одной расчетной плоскости по общему пользовательскому словарю.
Private Function PlaneStatus(ByVal batch As CBatchSectionCalculator, ByVal index As Long, ByVal planeIndex As Long) As String
    Dim policy As CResultStatusPolicy
    Set policy = StatusPolicy()
    If Not PlaneApplicable(batch, index, planeIndex) Then
        PlaneStatus = policy.NotApplicable
    ElseIf PlanePassed(batch, index, planeIndex) Then
        PlaneStatus = policy.OK
    Else
        PlaneStatus = policy.Fail
    End If
End Function

' Однотипные accessors ниже выбирают данные первой или второй главной
' плоскости из batch-результата. Они держат разметку таблицы независимой от
' конкретных имен свойств Stability...1/Stability...2.
Private Function PlaneApplicable(ByVal batch As CBatchSectionCalculator, ByVal index As Long, ByVal planeIndex As Long) As Boolean
    If planeIndex = 1 Then PlaneApplicable = batch.ResultAt(index).StabilityResult.PlaneApplicable1 Else PlaneApplicable = batch.ResultAt(index).StabilityResult.PlaneApplicable2
End Function

' Возвращает итог PASS/FAIL одной плоскости устойчивости.
Private Function PlanePassed(ByVal batch As CBatchSectionCalculator, ByVal index As Long, ByVal planeIndex As Long) As Boolean
    If planeIndex = 1 Then PlanePassed = batch.ResultAt(index).StabilityResult.PlanePassed1 Else PlanePassed = batch.ResultAt(index).StabilityResult.PlanePassed2
End Function

' Возвращает расчетную ветвь одной плоскости: SP35-table, SP35-eta или SP63.
Private Function PlaneBranch(ByVal batch As CBatchSectionCalculator, ByVal index As Long, ByVal planeIndex As Long) As String
    If planeIndex = 1 Then PlaneBranch = batch.ResultAt(index).StabilityResult.PlaneBranch1 Else PlaneBranch = batch.ResultAt(index).StabilityResult.PlaneBranch2
End Function

' Возвращает критическую силу Ncr одной плоскости.
Private Function PlaneNcr(ByVal batch As CBatchSectionCalculator, ByVal index As Long, ByVal planeIndex As Long) As Double
    If planeIndex = 1 Then PlaneNcr = batch.ResultAt(index).StabilityResult.Ncr1 Else PlaneNcr = batch.ResultAt(index).StabilityResult.Ncr2
End Function

' Возвращает табличную несущую силу Nult для ветви СП 35 ec <= r.
Private Function PlaneNultimate(ByVal batch As CBatchSectionCalculator, ByVal index As Long, ByVal planeIndex As Long) As Double
    If planeIndex = 1 Then PlaneNultimate = batch.ResultAt(index).StabilityResult.Nultimate1 Else PlaneNultimate = batch.ResultAt(index).StabilityResult.Nultimate2
End Function

' Возвращает коэффициент eta одной плоскости.
Private Function PlaneEta(ByVal batch As CBatchSectionCalculator, ByVal index As Long, ByVal planeIndex As Long) As Double
    If planeIndex = 1 Then PlaneEta = batch.ResultAt(index).StabilityResult.Eta1 Else PlaneEta = batch.ResultAt(index).StabilityResult.Eta2
End Function

' Возвращает коэффициент длительности phi_l одной плоскости.
Private Function PlanePhiL(ByVal batch As CBatchSectionCalculator, ByVal index As Long, ByVal planeIndex As Long) As Double
    If planeIndex = 1 Then PlanePhiL = batch.ResultAt(index).StabilityResult.PhiL1 Else PlanePhiL = batch.ResultAt(index).StabilityResult.PhiL2
End Function

' Возвращает табличный phi_l для ветви СП 35 ec <= r.
Private Function PlanePhiLTable(ByVal batch As CBatchSectionCalculator, ByVal index As Long, ByVal planeIndex As Long) As Double
    If planeIndex = 1 Then PlanePhiLTable = batch.ResultAt(index).StabilityResult.PhiLTable1 Else PlanePhiLTable = batch.ResultAt(index).StabilityResult.PhiLTable2
End Function

' Возвращает табличный phi_m для ветви СП 35 ec <= r.
Private Function PlanePhiM(ByVal batch As CBatchSectionCalculator, ByVal index As Long, ByVal planeIndex As Long) As Double
    If planeIndex = 1 Then PlanePhiM = batch.ResultAt(index).StabilityResult.PhiM1 Else PlanePhiM = batch.ResultAt(index).StabilityResult.PhiM2
End Function

' Возвращает итоговый phi для табличной ветви СП 35.
Private Function PlanePhiValue(ByVal batch As CBatchSectionCalculator, ByVal index As Long, ByVal planeIndex As Long) As Double
    If planeIndex = 1 Then PlanePhiValue = batch.ResultAt(index).StabilityResult.PhiValue1 Else PlanePhiValue = batch.ResultAt(index).StabilityResult.PhiValue2
End Function

' Возвращает полный эксцентриситет ec/e0 одной плоскости.
Private Function PlaneEccentricity(ByVal batch As CBatchSectionCalculator, ByVal index As Long, ByVal planeIndex As Long) As Double
    If planeIndex = 1 Then PlaneEccentricity = batch.ResultAt(index).StabilityResult.Eccentricity1 Else PlaneEccentricity = batch.ResultAt(index).StabilityResult.Eccentricity2
End Function

' Возвращает случайный эксцентриситет ec,sl/ea одной плоскости.
Private Function PlaneAccidentalEccentricity(ByVal batch As CBatchSectionCalculator, ByVal index As Long, ByVal planeIndex As Long) As Double
    If planeIndex = 1 Then PlaneAccidentalEccentricity = batch.ResultAt(index).StabilityResult.AccidentalEcc1 Else PlaneAccidentalEccentricity = batch.ResultAt(index).StabilityResult.AccidentalEcc2
End Function

' Возвращает гибкость l0/i одной плоскости.
Private Function PlaneSlenderness(ByVal batch As CBatchSectionCalculator, ByVal index As Long, ByVal planeIndex As Long) As Double
    If planeIndex = 1 Then PlaneSlenderness = batch.ResultAt(index).StabilityResult.Slenderness1 Else PlaneSlenderness = batch.ResultAt(index).StabilityResult.Slenderness2
End Function

' Возвращает ядровое расстояние r в направлении эксцентриситета.
Private Function PlaneCoreDistance(ByVal batch As CBatchSectionCalculator, ByVal index As Long, ByVal planeIndex As Long) As Double
    If planeIndex = 1 Then PlaneCoreDistance = batch.ResultAt(index).StabilityResult.CoreDistance1 Else PlaneCoreDistance = batch.ResultAt(index).StabilityResult.CoreDistance2
End Function

' Возвращает расчетную delta одной плоскости.
Private Function PlaneDelta(ByVal batch As CBatchSectionCalculator, ByVal index As Long, ByVal planeIndex As Long) As Double
    If planeIndex = 1 Then PlaneDelta = batch.ResultAt(index).StabilityResult.Delta1 Else PlaneDelta = batch.ResultAt(index).StabilityResult.Delta2
End Function

' Возвращает коэффициент kb для ветви СП 63.
Private Function PlaneKb(ByVal batch As CBatchSectionCalculator, ByVal index As Long, ByVal planeIndex As Long) As Double
    If planeIndex = 1 Then PlaneKb = batch.ResultAt(index).StabilityResult.Kb1 Else PlaneKb = batch.ResultAt(index).StabilityResult.Kb2
End Function

' Возвращает коэффициент ks для ветви СП 63.
Private Function PlaneKs(ByVal batch As CBatchSectionCalculator, ByVal index As Long, ByVal planeIndex As Long) As Double
    If planeIndex = 1 Then PlaneKs = batch.ResultAt(index).StabilityResult.Ks1 Else PlaneKs = batch.ResultAt(index).StabilityResult.Ks2
End Function

' Возвращает жесткость D одной плоскости.
Private Function PlaneStiffnessD(ByVal batch As CBatchSectionCalculator, ByVal index As Long, ByVal planeIndex As Long) As Double
    If planeIndex = 1 Then PlaneStiffnessD = batch.ResultAt(index).StabilityResult.StiffnessD1 Else PlaneStiffnessD = batch.ResultAt(index).StabilityResult.StiffnessD2
End Function

' Возвращает проверочный запас одной плоскости.
Private Function PlaneReserve(ByVal batch As CBatchSectionCalculator, ByVal index As Long, ByVal planeIndex As Long) As Double
    If planeIndex = 1 Then PlaneReserve = batch.ResultAt(index).StabilityResult.Reserve1 Else PlaneReserve = batch.ResultAt(index).StabilityResult.Reserve2
End Function

' Возвращает пустую ячейку для численного нуля, чтобы summary не шумела
' несущественными расчетными величинами.
Private Function OptionalValue(ByVal value As Double) As Variant
    If Abs(value) > SMALL_VALUE Then OptionalValue = value Else OptionalValue = vbNullString
End Function

' Выводит сжимающую силу только когда она физически есть; иначе возвращает
' стандартный N/A из политики статусов.
Private Function OptionalCompressionForce(ByVal compressionMagnitude As Double, ByVal units As CUnitSystem) As Variant
    If compressionMagnitude > SMALL_VALUE Then OptionalCompressionForce = OutputCompressionForce(compressionMagnitude, units) Else OptionalCompressionForce = StatusPolicy().NotApplicable
End Function

' Возвращает коэффициент запаса limit/Ncompression для ограничения СП 35.
Private Function RatioLimitToCompression(ByVal limitCompression As Double, ByVal nValue As Double) As Variant
    Dim compression As Double
    compression = compressionMagnitude(nValue)
    If compression <= SMALL_VALUE Or limitCompression <= SMALL_VALUE Then
        RatioLimitToCompression = vbNullString
    Else
        RatioLimitToCompression = limitCompression / compression
    End If
End Function

' Преобразует signed N во внутреннюю положительную величину сжатия.
Private Function compressionMagnitude(ByVal nValue As Double) As Double
    Dim loadState As CSectionLoadState
    Set loadState = New CSectionLoadState
    loadState.Initialize nValue, 0#, 0#, 0#, 0#
    compressionMagnitude = loadState.compressionMagnitude(SMALL_VALUE)
End Function

' Переводит положительную величину сжатия в пользовательские единицы силы
' с учетом принятого знака Output.SignConvention.N.
Private Function OutputCompressionForce(ByVal compressionMagnitude As Double, ByVal units As CUnitSystem) As Double
    If compressionMagnitude <= SMALL_VALUE Then Exit Function
    OutputCompressionForce = OutputForce(-Abs(compressionMagnitude), units)
End Function

' Выводит подписанную сжимающую силу как пользовательское значение N.
Private Function OutputSignedCompressionForce(ByVal signedCompression As Double, ByVal units As CUnitSystem) As Double
    OutputSignedCompressionForce = OutputForce(-signedCompression, units)
End Function

' Группа функций Output... ниже только переводит внутренние единицы устойчивости
' в пользовательские выходные единицы для Results.
Private Function OutputLength(ByVal value As Double, ByVal units As CUnitSystem) As Double
    If units Is Nothing Then OutputLength = value Else OutputLength = units.InternalLengthToOutput(value)
End Function

' Возвращает подпись выходной единицы длины.
Private Function OutputLengthUnit(ByVal units As CUnitSystem) As String
    If units Is Nothing Then OutputLengthUnit = "mm" Else OutputLengthUnit = units.OutputLengthUnit
End Function

' Переводит внутреннюю силу в пользовательские выходные единицы.
Private Function OutputForce(ByVal value As Double, ByVal units As CUnitSystem) As Double
    If units Is Nothing Then OutputForce = value Else OutputForce = units.InternalForceToOutput(value)
End Function

' Возвращает подпись выходной единицы силы.
Private Function OutputForceUnit(ByVal units As CUnitSystem) As String
    If units Is Nothing Then OutputForceUnit = "N" Else OutputForceUnit = units.OutputForceUnit
End Function

' Переводит внутренний Mx в пользовательские выходные единицы и знак.
Private Function OutputMx(ByVal value As Double, ByVal units As CUnitSystem) As Double
    If units Is Nothing Then OutputMx = value Else OutputMx = units.InternalMomentMxToOutput(value)
End Function

' Переводит внутренний My в пользовательские выходные единицы и знак.
Private Function OutputMy(ByVal value As Double, ByVal units As CUnitSystem) As Double
    If units Is Nothing Then OutputMy = value Else OutputMy = units.InternalMomentMyToOutput(value)
End Function

' Переводит модуль момента без назначения знака конкретной оси.
Private Function OutputMomentMagnitude(ByVal value As Double, ByVal units As CUnitSystem) As Double
    If units Is Nothing Then OutputMomentMagnitude = value Else OutputMomentMagnitude = units.InternalMomentMagnitudeToOutput(value)
End Function

' Возвращает подпись выходной единицы момента.
Private Function OutputMomentUnit(ByVal units As CUnitSystem) As String
    If units Is Nothing Then OutputMomentUnit = "N*mm" Else OutputMomentUnit = units.OutputMomentUnit
End Function

' Переводит жесткость D из Н*мм2 в выбранные выходные единицы.
Private Function OutputStiffness(ByVal value As Double, ByVal units As CUnitSystem) As Double
    If units Is Nothing Then OutputStiffness = value Else OutputStiffness = units.InternalForceLengthSquaredToOutput(value)
End Function

' Возвращает подпись выходной единицы жесткости.
Private Function OutputStiffnessUnit(ByVal units As CUnitSystem) As String
    If units Is Nothing Then OutputStiffnessUnit = "N*mm2" Else OutputStiffnessUnit = units.OutputForceLengthSquaredUnit
End Function

' Утилитарный максимум без WorksheetFunction для форматирования таблицы.
Private Function MaxDouble(ByVal a As Double, ByVal b As Double) As Double
    If a > b Then MaxDouble = a Else MaxDouble = b
End Function

' Возвращает общую политику отображения статусов PASS/FAIL/N/A.
Private Function StatusPolicy() As CResultStatusPolicy
    Static policy As CResultStatusPolicy
    If policy Is Nothing Then Set policy = New CResultStatusPolicy
    Set StatusPolicy = policy
End Function

Option Explicit

' ==========================================================================
' Подробная таблица НДС по прочности и несущей способности на листе Results
' ==========================================================================
' Класс пишет отдельный блок от якоря rngStrengthSummaryAnchor: прямое НДС
' заданного сочетания по модели прочности и расчет предельной несущей
' способности по той же strength-модели. Расчет здесь не выполняется: writer
' берет уже сохраненные named states StrengthState и CapacityState, переводит
' величины в пользовательские единицы и оформляет таблицу. Верхний
' rngBatchSummary остается компактной сводкой, а этот блок раскрывает именно
' результаты НДС по модели прочности, включая несущую способность.
'
' Для отсутствующих физических зон writer оставляет пустые ячейки. Например,
' если в диаграмме бетона растяжение отключено или все сечение растянуто, то
' сжатые/растянутые деформации и напряжения не подменяются ближайшими
' значениями другого знака.

Private Const HEADER_ROWS As Long = 4 ' Строки шапки над первой строкой LC.
Private Const TOTAL_COLUMNS As Long = 49 ' Полная ширина с двумя пустыми разделителями.

Private Const COL_LEFT_FIRST As Long = 1
Private Const COL_LEFT_LAST As Long = 9
Private Const COL_SEPARATOR1 As Long = 10
Private Const COL_STATE_FIRST As Long = 11
Private Const COL_STATE_LAST As Long = 30
Private Const COL_SEPARATOR2 As Long = 31
Private Const COL_CAPACITY_FIRST As Long = 32
Private Const COL_CAPACITY_LAST As Long = 49

Private Const COL_ID As Long = 1
Private Const COL_RESULT_COMMENT As Long = 2
Private Const COL_STATUS As Long = 3
Private Const COL_REF_N As Long = 4
Private Const COL_REF_MX As Long = 5
Private Const COL_REF_MY As Long = 6
Private Const COL_LOAD_N As Long = 7
Private Const COL_LOAD_MX As Long = 8
Private Const COL_LOAD_MY As Long = 9

Private Const COL_LIM_EBC As Long = 11
Private Const COL_LIM_EBT As Long = 12
Private Const COL_LIM_ESC As Long = 13
Private Const COL_LIM_EST As Long = 14
Private Const COL_STATE_EPS0 As Long = 15
Private Const COL_STATE_KX As Long = 16
Private Const COL_STATE_KY As Long = 17
Private Const COL_STATE_EBC As Long = 18
Private Const COL_STATE_EBT As Long = 19
Private Const COL_STATE_ESC As Long = 20
Private Const COL_STATE_EST As Long = 21
Private Const COL_STATE_SBC As Long = 22

Private Const HEADER_COLOR As Long = &HD9D9D9 ' Серый фон шапки, как в остальных подробных блоках.
Private Const SMALL_VALUE As Double = 0.000000001 ' Численный порог только для пустых расчетных полей writer-а.
Private Const HEADER_NOTES_ROW As Long = 3
Private Const HEADER_LABEL_ROW As Long = 4

' Возвращает число строк шапки над rngStrengthSummaryAnchor.
Public Function HeaderRowsAboveAnchor() As Long
    HeaderRowsAboveAnchor = HEADER_ROWS
End Function

' Возвращает полную высоту блока: шапка плюс строки сочетаний.
Public Function RequiredRows(ByVal combinationCount As Long) As Long
    If combinationCount < 1 Then combinationCount = 1
    RequiredRows = HEADER_ROWS + combinationCount
End Function

' Возвращает число строк данных по высоте rngLoadCombinations, чтобы пустые
' доступные строки тоже получили рамки и не выглядели как остаток старого вывода.
Public Function RequiredDataRowsForWorkbook(ByVal Workbook As Object, ByVal combinationCount As Long) As Long
    RequiredDataRowsForWorkbook = combinationCount
    If RequiredDataRowsForWorkbook < 1 Then RequiredDataRowsForWorkbook = 1

    On Error GoTo SafeExit
    If Workbook Is Nothing Then GoTo SafeExit
    Dim loads As Object
    Set loads = Workbook.names.item("rngLoadCombinations").RefersToRange
    If loads.rows.count > 1 Then
        If loads.rows.count - 1 > RequiredDataRowsForWorkbook Then _
            RequiredDataRowsForWorkbook = loads.rows.count - 1
    End If
SafeExit:
    If RequiredDataRowsForWorkbook < 1 Then RequiredDataRowsForWorkbook = 1
End Function

' Возвращает полную высоту блока для фактической книги.
Public Function RequiredRowsForWorkbook(ByVal Workbook As Object, ByVal combinationCount As Long) As Long
    RequiredRowsForWorkbook = RequiredRows(RequiredDataRowsForWorkbook(Workbook, combinationCount))
End Function

' Возвращает ширину блока вместе с пустыми разделителями.
Public Function RequiredColumns() As Long
    RequiredColumns = TOTAL_COLUMNS
End Function

' Записывает подробную таблицу НДС/Capacity по модели прочности.
Public Sub WriteSummary(ByVal Workbook As Object, ByVal batch As CBatchSectionCalculator, _
        Optional ByVal units As CUnitSystem = Nothing, Optional ByVal section As CSectionModel = Nothing)
    On Error GoTo Failed
    If Workbook Is Nothing Then Err.Raise vbObjectError + 3996, "CStrengthSummaryWriter", "Книга Excel не передана."
    If batch Is Nothing Then Err.Raise vbObjectError + 3997, "CStrengthSummaryWriter", "Пакетный расчетчик не передан."

    Dim target As Object
    Set target = TargetRange(Workbook, RequiredDataRowsForWorkbook(Workbook, batch.count))
    PrepareTarget target
    WriteBlockTitle target, "Расчет НДС и несущей способности по модели прочности"
    WriteHeaders target, units
    WriteData target, batch, units, section
    FormatTable target, batch
    Exit Sub

Failed:
    Err.Raise Err.number, "CStrengthSummaryWriter.WriteSummary", Err.description
End Sub

' Очищает старый detailed-блок прочности вместе с объединениями и форматами.
Public Sub ClearSummary(ByVal Workbook As Object)
    If Workbook Is Nothing Then Err.Raise vbObjectError + 3998, "CStrengthSummaryWriter", "Книга Excel не передана."
    PrepareTarget ClearTargetRange(Workbook)
End Sub

' Возвращает текущий диапазон таблицы: шапка над якорем и строки LC.
Private Function TargetRange(ByVal Workbook As Object, Optional ByVal dataRows As Long = 1) As Object
    Dim anchor As Object
    Set anchor = Workbook.names.item("rngStrengthSummaryAnchor").RefersToRange
    If anchor.row <= HEADER_ROWS Then Err.Raise vbObjectError + 3999, "CStrengthSummaryWriter", _
        "rngStrengthSummaryAnchor должен иметь место для шапки над собой."
    Set TargetRange = anchor.offset(-HEADER_ROWS, 0).Resize(RequiredRows(dataRows), TOTAL_COLUMNS)
End Function

' Возвращает область безопасной очистки до следующего detailed-блока Results.
Private Function ClearTargetRange(ByVal Workbook As Object) As Object
    Dim anchor As Object
    Set anchor = Workbook.names.item("rngStrengthSummaryAnchor").RefersToRange
    If anchor.row <= HEADER_ROWS Then Err.Raise vbObjectError + 3999, "CStrengthSummaryWriter", _
        "rngStrengthSummaryAnchor должен иметь место для шапки над собой."

    Dim topRow As Long
    topRow = anchor.row - HEADER_ROWS

    Dim rowsToClear As Long
    rowsToClear = RequiredRows(1)
    On Error GoTo UseDefaultHeight
    Dim crackWriter As CCrackSummaryWriter
    Set crackWriter = New CCrackSummaryWriter
    Dim crackAnchor As Object
    Set crackAnchor = Workbook.names.item("rngCrackSummaryAnchor").RefersToRange
    Dim crackTopRow As Long
    crackTopRow = crackAnchor.row - crackWriter.HeaderRowsAboveAnchor
    If crackTopRow > topRow Then rowsToClear = crackTopRow - topRow

UseDefaultHeight:
    If topRow + rowsToClear - 1 > anchor.Worksheet.rows.count Then rowsToClear = anchor.Worksheet.rows.count - topRow + 1
    Set ClearTargetRange = anchor.Worksheet.cells(topRow, anchor.column).Resize(rowsToClear, TOTAL_COLUMNS)
End Function

' Снимает старые объединения и очищает значения/форматы перед новой записью.
Private Sub PrepareTarget(ByVal target As Object)
    ClearBlockTitleRow target
    target.UnMerge
    target.clear
End Sub

' Записывает отдельную строку-название над detailed-блоком, не вмешиваясь в многоуровневую шапку таблицы.
Private Sub WriteBlockTitle(ByVal target As Object, ByVal titleText As String)
    If target.row <= 1 Then Exit Sub

    Dim titleRow As Long
    titleRow = target.row - 1
    target.Worksheet.cells(titleRow, target.column).Resize(1, TOTAL_COLUMNS).Interior.color = RGB(189, 215, 238)
    target.Worksheet.rows.item(titleRow).RowHeight = 15
    With target.Worksheet.cells(titleRow, target.column)
        .value2 = titleText
        .font.name = "Arial"
        .font.size = 12
        .font.Bold = True
        .font.color = RGB(255, 0, 0)
        .HorizontalAlignment = -4131
        .VerticalAlignment = -4108
        .WrapText = False
    End With
End Sub

' Очищает название и заливку только в ширине блока прочности. Ячейки справа
' принадлежат другим данным листа и не должны изменяться при повторной записи.
Private Sub ClearBlockTitleRow(ByVal target As Object)
    If target.row <= 1 Then Exit Sub
    target.Worksheet.cells(target.row - 1, target.column).Resize(1, TOTAL_COLUMNS).clear
    target.Worksheet.rows.item(target.row - 1).RowHeight = 15
End Sub

' Формирует многоуровневую шапку таблицы.
Private Sub WriteHeaders(ByVal target As Object, ByVal units As CUnitSystem)
    Dim headers() As Variant
    ReDim headers(1 To HEADER_ROWS, 1 To TOTAL_COLUMNS)

    headers(1, COL_ID) = "Combination ID"
    headers(1, COL_RESULT_COMMENT) = "ResultComment"
    headers(1, COL_STATUS) = "общий статус"
    headers(1, COL_REF_N) = "относительно центральных осей приведенного сечения"
    headers(1, COL_LOAD_N) = "в точке приложения нагрузок"
    headers(1, COL_LIM_EBC) = "Общие данные"
    headers(1, COL_STATE_EPS0) = "НДС от заданного сочетания нагрузок (по модели прочности)"
    headers(1, COL_CAP_EPS0) = "Расчет предельной несущей способности по выбранной " & ChrW$(&H3BB) & "-траектории (по модели прочности)"

    headers(2, COL_STATE_EPS0) = "плоскость деформации"
    headers(2, COL_STATE_EBC) = "фактические макс. деформации"
    headers(2, COL_STATE_SBC) = "фактические напряжения"
    headers(2, COL_STATE_H) = "параметры сечения и статус"
    headers(2, COL_CAP_EPS0) = "плоскость деформации"
    headers(2, COL_CAP_LIMIT_STATE) = "параметры расчета"
    headers(2, COL_CAP_LAMBDA) = "предельные компоненты"
    headers(2, COL_CAP_EBC) = "фактические макс. деформации"
    headers(2, COL_CAP_H) = "параметры сечения при " & ChrW$(&H3BB) & "ult и статус"

    PutHeaderNotes headers
    PutColumnLabels headers, units
    target.Resize(HEADER_ROWS, TOTAL_COLUMNS).value2 = headers
    MergeHeaders target
End Sub

    headers(HEADER_LABEL_ROW, COL_CAP_STATUS) = "статус"
End Sub

' Объединяет прямоугольные участки шапки.
Private Sub MergeHeaders(ByVal target As Object)
    MergeRange target, 1, COL_ID, HEADER_LABEL_ROW, COL_ID
    MergeRange target, 1, COL_RESULT_COMMENT, HEADER_LABEL_ROW, COL_RESULT_COMMENT
    MergeRange target, 1, COL_STATUS, HEADER_LABEL_ROW, COL_STATUS
    MergeRange target, 1, COL_REF_N, 2, COL_REF_MY
    MergeRange target, 1, COL_LOAD_N, 2, COL_LOAD_MY
    MergeRange target, 1, COL_LIM_EBC, 2, COL_LIM_EST
    MergeRange target, 1, COL_STATE_EPS0, 1, COL_STATE_STATUS
    MergeRange target, 2, COL_STATE_EPS0, 2, COL_STATE_KY
    MergeRange target, 2, COL_STATE_EBC, 2, COL_STATE_EST
    MergeRange target, 2, COL_STATE_SBC, 2, COL_STATE_SST
    MergeRange target, 2, COL_STATE_H, 2, COL_STATE_STATUS
    MergeRange target, 1, COL_CAP_EPS0, 1, COL_CAP_STATUS
    MergeRange target, 2, COL_CAP_EPS0, 2, COL_CAP_KY
    MergeRange target, 2, COL_CAP_LIMIT_STATE, 2, COL_CAP_METHOD
    MergeRange target, 2, COL_CAP_LAMBDA, 2, COL_CAP_MY
    MergeRange target, 2, COL_CAP_EBC, 2, COL_CAP_EST
    MergeRange target, 2, COL_CAP_H, 2, COL_CAP_STATUS
End Sub

' Записывает строки сочетаний одним массивом.
Private Sub WriteData(ByVal target As Object, ByVal batch As CBatchSectionCalculator, _
        ByVal units As CUnitSystem, ByVal section As CSectionModel)
    Dim dataRows As Long
    dataRows = target.rows.count - HEADER_ROWS
    If dataRows <= 0 Then Exit Sub

    Dim data() As Variant
    ReDim data(1 To dataRows, 1 To TOTAL_COLUMNS)

    Dim i As Long
    For i = 1 To batch.count
        PutCombination data, OutputDataOffset(batch, i, dataRows), batch, i, units, section
    Next i
    target.offset(HEADER_ROWS, 0).Resize(dataRows, TOTAL_COLUMNS).value2 = data
End Sub

' Заполняет одну строку detailed-блока прочности.
Private Sub PutCombination(ByRef data() As Variant, ByVal rowIndex As Long, _
        ByVal batch As CBatchSectionCalculator, ByVal index As Long, _
        ByVal units As CUnitSystem, ByVal section As CSectionModel)
    Dim policy As CResultStatusPolicy
    Set policy = StatusPolicy()

    data(rowIndex, COL_ID) = batch.combinationID(index)
    data(rowIndex, COL_RESULT_COMMENT) = MetaComment(batch.ResultAt(index).StrengthMeta)
    data(rowIndex, COL_STATUS) = policy.ExternalStatus(batch.ResultAt(index).StrengthMeta)
    data(rowIndex, COL_STATE_STATUS) = policy.NotApplicable
    data(rowIndex, COL_CAP_STATUS) = policy.NotApplicable

    If Not batch.StrengthDirectStateRequested(index) And Not batch.StrengthCapacityRequested(index) Then Exit Sub

    data(rowIndex, COL_REF_N) = OutputForce(batch.StrengthReferenceN(index), units)
    data(rowIndex, COL_REF_MX) = OutputMx(batch.StrengthReferenceMx(index), units)
    data(rowIndex, COL_REF_MY) = OutputMy(batch.StrengthReferenceMy(index), units)
    data(rowIndex, COL_LOAD_N) = OutputForce(batch.StrengthLoadPointN(index), units)
    data(rowIndex, COL_LOAD_MX) = OutputMx(batch.StrengthLoadPointMx(index), units)
    data(rowIndex, COL_LOAD_MY) = OutputMy(batch.StrengthLoadPointMy(index), units)

    PutStrengthLimits data, rowIndex, batch, index, units
    PutStrengthState data, rowIndex, batch, index, units, section, policy
    PutCapacityState data, rowIndex, batch, index, units, section, policy
End Sub

' Возвращает позицию LC внутри data-части подробной таблицы.
' Основной поток читает offset из rngLoadCombinations; прямые тесты без offset продолжают выводиться компактно.
Private Function OutputDataOffset(ByVal batch As CBatchSectionCalculator, ByVal index As Long, ByVal dataRows As Long) As Long
    OutputDataOffset = batch.SourceDataOffset(index)
    If OutputDataOffset < 1 Then OutputDataOffset = index
    If OutputDataOffset > dataRows Then OutputDataOffset = index
    If OutputDataOffset > dataRows Then OutputDataOffset = dataRows
End Function

' Записывает физические предельные деформации effective strength-модели LC.
' Растянутый предел бетона выводится только при включенной растянутой ветви.
Private Sub PutStrengthLimits(ByRef data() As Variant, ByVal rowIndex As Long, _
        ByVal batch As CBatchSectionCalculator, ByVal index As Long, ByVal units As CUnitSystem)
    data(rowIndex, COL_LIM_EBC) = batch.StrengthConcreteCompressionLimitForCombination(index)
    If batch.StrengthConcreteTensionLimitEnabledForCombination(index) Then _
        data(rowIndex, COL_LIM_EBT) = batch.StrengthConcreteTensionLimitForCombination(index)
    data(rowIndex, COL_LIM_ESC) = batch.StrengthSteelCompressionLimitForCombination(index)
    data(rowIndex, COL_LIM_EST) = batch.StrengthSteelTensionLimitForCombination(index)
End Sub

' Пишет фактический StrengthState, если он действительно был рассчитан.
Private Sub PutStrengthState(ByRef data() As Variant, ByVal rowIndex As Long, _
        ByVal batch As CBatchSectionCalculator, ByVal index As Long, _
        ByVal units As CUnitSystem, ByVal section As CSectionModel, ByVal policy As CResultStatusPolicy)
    If Not batch.StrengthDirectStateRequested(index) Then
        data(rowIndex, COL_STATE_STATUS) = policy.NotApplicable
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim stateResult As CSectionStateResult
    Set stateResult = batch.ResultAt(index).StateRepository.FindState(sstStrengthState)
    If stateResult Is Nothing Then
        data(rowIndex, COL_STATE_STATUS) = DirectStatusText(batch, index, policy)
        Exit Sub
    End If

    PutStatePlane data, rowIndex, stateResult, units, COL_STATE_EPS0, COL_STATE_KX, COL_STATE_KY
    PutStateExtremes data, rowIndex, stateResult, units, _
        COL_STATE_EBC, COL_STATE_EBT, COL_STATE_ESC, COL_STATE_EST, _
        COL_STATE_SBC, COL_STATE_SBT, COL_STATE_SSC, COL_STATE_SST
    PutStateGeometry data, rowIndex, stateResult, units, section, COL_STATE_H, COL_STATE_X
    data(rowIndex, COL_STATE_DIAGEXT) = ExtensionUsedText(batch, index, stateResult)
    If batch.ResultAt(index).StrengthResult.DirectState.StrainReserve > SMALL_VALUE Then _
        data(rowIndex, COL_STATE_RESERVE) = batch.ResultAt(index).StrengthResult.DirectState.StrainReserve
    data(rowIndex, COL_STATE_STATUS) = policy.ExternalStatus(stateResult.ResultMeta)
End Sub

' Показывает использование продолжения диаграммы только тогда, когда само
' продолжение разрешено настройкой General.DiagramExtension.
' При выключенной настройке выводится "-", потому что extension не мог
' применяться и обычная пара yes/no здесь не несет полезного смысла.
Private Function ExtensionUsedText(ByVal batch As CBatchSectionCalculator, _
        ByVal index As Long, ByVal stateResult As CSectionStateResult) As String
    If Not batch.ResultAt(index).diagramExtensionEnabled Then
        ExtensionUsedText = "-"
    ElseIf stateResult.extensionUsed Then
        ExtensionUsedText = "yes"
    Else
        ExtensionUsedText = "no"
    End If
End Function

' Выводит путь, метод, статус несущей и найденное физическое CapacityState.
' Если конечного НДС нет, writer не создает плоскость или усилия из последней
' диагностической пробы; числовые поля заполняются только сохраненной точкой.
Private Sub PutCapacityState(ByRef data() As Variant, ByVal rowIndex As Long, _
        ByVal batch As CBatchSectionCalculator, ByVal index As Long, _
        ByVal units As CUnitSystem, ByVal section As CSectionModel, ByVal policy As CResultStatusPolicy)
    If Not batch.StrengthCapacityRequested(index) Then
        data(rowIndex, COL_CAP_STATUS) = policy.NotApplicable
        Exit Sub
    End If

    data(rowIndex, COL_CAP_LIMIT_STATE) = batch.ResultAt(index).StrengthResult.capacity.LimitState
    data(rowIndex, COL_CAP_LOAD_PATH) = batch.ResultAt(index).CapacityPathDisplayName
    data(rowIndex, COL_CAP_METHOD) = batch.ResultAt(index).StrengthResult.capacity.solutionMethod
    If batch.ResultAt(index).StrengthResult.capacity.LambdaCapacity > SMALL_VALUE Then data(rowIndex, COL_CAP_LAMBDA) = batch.ResultAt(index).StrengthResult.capacity.LambdaCapacity

    Dim stateResult As CSectionStateResult
    Set stateResult = batch.ResultAt(index).StateRepository.FindState(sstCapacityState)
    If Not stateResult Is Nothing Then
        PutStatePlane data, rowIndex, stateResult, units, COL_CAP_EPS0, COL_CAP_KX, COL_CAP_KY
        PutCapacityLoadPointComponents data, rowIndex, batch, index, units
        PutStateExtremes data, rowIndex, stateResult, units, _
            COL_CAP_EBC, COL_CAP_EBT, COL_CAP_ESC, COL_CAP_EST, _
            0, 0, 0, 0
        PutStateGeometry data, rowIndex, stateResult, units, section, COL_CAP_H, COL_CAP_X
    End If
    If batch.ResultAt(index).StrengthResult.capacity.ReserveFactor > SMALL_VALUE Then _
        data(rowIndex, COL_CAP_RESERVE) = batch.ResultAt(index).StrengthResult.capacity.ReserveFactor
    data(rowIndex, COL_CAP_STATUS) = CapacityStatusText(batch, index, policy)
End Sub

' Выводит полный предельный вектор CapacityState в точке приложения нагрузки.
Private Sub PutCapacityLoadPointComponents(ByRef data() As Variant, ByVal rowIndex As Long, _
        ByVal batch As CBatchSectionCalculator, ByVal index As Long, ByVal units As CUnitSystem)
    data(rowIndex, COL_CAP_N) = OutputForce(batch.ResultAt(index).StrengthResult.capacity.nUltimate, units)
    data(rowIndex, COL_CAP_MX) = OutputMx(batch.ResultAt(index).StrengthResult.capacity.mxUltimate, units)
    data(rowIndex, COL_CAP_MY) = OutputMy(batch.ResultAt(index).StrengthResult.capacity.myUltimate, units)
End Sub

' Пишет параметры плоскости деформаций saved-state: epsilon0 в начале
' внутренней системы координат модели и две кривизны в OUTPUT-единицах.
Private Sub PutStatePlane(ByRef data() As Variant, ByVal rowIndex As Long, _
        ByVal stateResult As CSectionStateResult, ByVal units As CUnitSystem, _
        ByVal colEps0 As Long, ByVal colKx As Long, ByVal colKy As Long)
    data(rowIndex, colEps0) = stateResult.epsilon0
    data(rowIndex, colKx) = OutputCurvature(stateResult.kappaX, units)
    data(rowIndex, colKy) = OutputCurvature(stateResult.kappaY, units)
End Sub

' Пишет экстремумы состояния по флагам наличия физической зоны.
Private Sub PutStateExtremes(ByRef data() As Variant, ByVal rowIndex As Long, _
        ByVal stateResult As CSectionStateResult, ByVal units As CUnitSystem, _
        ByVal colEbc As Long, ByVal colEbt As Long, ByVal colEsc As Long, ByVal colEst As Long, _
        ByVal colSbc As Long, ByVal colSbt As Long, ByVal colSsc As Long, ByVal colSst As Long)
    If stateResult.HasConcreteCompression Then data(rowIndex, colEbc) = stateResult.minConcreteStrain
    If stateResult.HasConcreteTension Then data(rowIndex, colEbt) = stateResult.maxConcreteStrain
    If stateResult.HasSteelCompression Then data(rowIndex, colEsc) = stateResult.MinSteelStrain
    If stateResult.HasSteelTension Then data(rowIndex, colEst) = stateResult.MaxSteelStrain

    If colSbc > 0 And stateResult.HasConcreteCompression Then data(rowIndex, colSbc) = OutputStress(stateResult.MinConcreteStress, units)
    If colSbt > 0 And stateResult.HasConcreteTension Then data(rowIndex, colSbt) = OutputStress(stateResult.MaxConcreteStress, units)
    If colSsc > 0 And stateResult.HasSteelCompression Then data(rowIndex, colSsc) = OutputStress(stateResult.MinSteelStress, units)
    If colSst > 0 And stateResult.HasSteelTension Then data(rowIndex, colSst) = OutputStress(stateResult.MaxSteelStress, units)
End Sub

' Пишет h и x для плоскости деформаций named state.
Private Sub PutStateGeometry(ByRef data() As Variant, ByVal rowIndex As Long, _
        ByVal stateResult As CSectionStateResult, ByVal units As CUnitSystem, _
        ByVal section As CSectionModel, ByVal colH As Long, ByVal colX As Long)
    If section Is Nothing Then Exit Sub

    Dim depthH As Double
    Dim compressedDepth As Double
    CalculateDepthsPerpendicularToNeutral section, stateResult.epsilon0, stateResult.kappaX, stateResult.kappaY, _
        depthH, compressedDepth
    If depthH > 0# Then data(rowIndex, colH) = OutputLength(depthH, units)
    If compressedDepth >= 0# Then data(rowIndex, colX) = OutputLength(compressedDepth, units)
End Sub

' Оформляет шапку, рамки, число и подсветку статусов.
Private Sub FormatTable(ByVal target As Object, ByVal batch As CBatchSectionCalculator)
    target.font.name = "Arial"
